label: x after o/z at step 3-4 in y-initial sequences
predicate: (in_tok == tok("x")) & (phase == 0) & isin(prev_tok, [tok("o"), tok("z")]) & isin(t, [3,4]) & (first_tok == tok("y")) & isin(prev2_tok, [tok("o"), tok("z"), tok("t"), tok("g")])
explanation: Extremely sparse (45 of 1M sequences). Fires only in the original phase at t=3 (81% of mass) or t=4, when the input is x right after o or z, almost always in sequences that start with y. It is strongest for y o o x (max), then y g z o x and y z o x, so magnitude rises when the preceding tokens are o/z (y o o > y z o > y z z > others). Weak activations (<0.1) also occur for non-y starts like j o z x, 2 o z x. Many y ? o x contexts with other middle tokens (h, u, v, n, q, digits) do not fire, so the prefix-set condition is a fit to few examples. Never fires on the delimiter or copy phases, or on any input other than x.
